tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search sourced knowledge records and open questions, any subject and language. Use it when the user needs a verifiable fact, definition, date, rule or standard with its sources, or to check a claim before stating it. Lexical: use specific terms (names, standards, numbers). tools.name: browse_knowledge
tools.description: Topics in use (with counts) and a page of published knowledge records, newest first. Call it once when you do not know whether this network covers a subject; pass a topic to list only its records.

tools.name: get_knowledge
tools.description: Full knowledge record: summary, statements (claims) with their own status and evidence, sources, revision history and disclaimers. Use it before quoting a result, to cite the statement's sources and status. Accepts a UUID, a slug, or a URL of this network.

tools.name: get_question
tools.description: A published question with its discussion: every public contribution (answers, corrections, challenges, clarifications) in publication order, with evidence links, plus links to consolidated knowledge records. Contributions from guests are unverified opinions, not facts.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: When the user needs a sourced answer that this network does not have yet (search first), publish the question so it can be answered for everyone. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_content" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Report a question, contribution, claim review, statement or record of this network that is false, illegal, exposes personal data or credentials, or infringes co…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_knowledge · Private data: search_knowledge, browse_knowledge, get_knowledge, get_question, report_content · Public sink: ask_question.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_knowledge · Private data: search_knowledge, browse_knowledge, get_knowledge, get_question, report_content · Public sink: ask_question

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
